verdict.rationale: Kommo documents its own marketplace with more than 100 integrations available on the Base plan, and developers can publish integrations there. However, the evidence names only messaging and commerce integrations (WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Shopify), not the categories the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of Slack, support-desk, marketing and data-warehouse integrations in the marketplace, documentation of the ops-user install flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: You only need a Base plan to integrate all your messengers and more than 100 other integrations on our marketplace.
If you are developing an integration that could be useful for all Kommo users, you can publish it in Kommo Marketplace.
Kommo integrates with WhatsApp and Instagram, and also supports TikTok, Shopify, Lazada, Nuvemshop, and other major platforms.
